pokedexEntries.bk: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

pokedexEntries.wh: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Wanting more garbage, they follow people who litter. They always belch poison gas.

pokedexEntries.x: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.or: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.y: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

pokedexEntries.as: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

pokedexEntries.su: Unsanitary places are what they like best. They can be spotted in Alola, often with Grimer in hot pursuit.

pokedexEntries.mo: It gorges on trash until its stomach is full. Then it belches toxic gas. An unlucky whiff of gas will put a person in the hospital.

pokedexEntries.us: Poisonous gas leaks out of it when it breathes. Muk that catch a whiff of that stench will come drooling.

pokedexEntries.um: If a young Pokémon or child breathes in the toxic gas that Trubbish belches out, it could be a life-threatening situation.

pokedexEntries.sw: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

pokedexEntries.sh: This Pokémon was born from a bag stuffed with trash. Galarian Weezing relish the fumes belched by Trubbish.

pokedexEntries.za: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.
